description: Exact rational computer-assisted order-7 flag-algebra certificate for the K4^(3) tetrahedron Turan problem
mathematical_scope: For an edge-density maximizer in the K4^(3)-free limit space, the first nontrivial order-7 vertex-stationarity identity is zero. Adding an arbitrary multiple of that identity and nonnegative rooted flag squares yields the pointwise seven-vertex coefficient bound verified here.

exact_verification.all_Gram_matrices: represented as sums of integer outer products divided by scale^2
exact_verification.coefficient_arithmetic: signed 128-bit integer arithmetic in the exhaustive oracle
exact_verification.independent_max_mask_check: independent_check_max_mask.py reproduces the exact maximum numerator from the maximizing mask

status_note: The included verifier passes using exact integer arithmetic in the supplied environment. The implementation has not yet undergone independent external code review or peer review; independent reproduction in another flag-algebra implementation is recommended before a publication claim.
maximizer_note: The maximum coefficient is attained by multiple raw labeled seven-vertex masks; the recorded mask is one example.
